workflow.content:
name: Cosmic Transcriber Web Release CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'release/**', 'ci/**']
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  resolve-lock:
    name: Resolve one reviewed dependency graph
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '26.7.0'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Activate reviewed npm
        run: npm install --global npm@12.0.2 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Verify tool versions
        run: |
          node --version
          test "$(node --version)" = "v26.7.0"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "12.0.2"
      - name: Refresh all direct dependencies to registry latest and resolve one graph
        run: node scripts/deps-latest.mjs
      - name: Verify reviewed install-script policy
        run: npm run deps:install-scripts:verify
      - name: Verify complete installed dependency tree
        run: npm ls --all
      - name: Audit resolved graph
        run: npm audit
      - name: Require direct dependencies to be current
        run: npm outdated --depth=0
      - name: Provision audio fixture toolchain
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: node scripts/provision-ci-media.mjs
      - name: Generate deterministic MP3 and nine-format fixtures
        run: node scripts/generate-test-fixtures.mjs
      - name: Full dependency-free adversarial gate
        run: npm run validate
      - name: Verify exact approved single MP3 bytes (no provider calls)
        run: node --input-type=module -e "import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; import {verifyFixedMp3} from './scripts/staging-single-mp3-smoke.mjs'; verifyFixedMp3(await readFile('tests/fixtures/approved-single-mp3/staging-speech.mp3'));"
      - name: Preserve only the approved MP3 for the manual smoke workflow
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: cosmic-approved-single-mp3-fixture
          path: tests/fixtures/approved-single-mp3/staging-speech.mp3
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Validate exactly the eight approved synthetic speech fixtures (no provider calls)
        run: node scripts/prepare-remaining-eight-fixtures.mjs tests/fixtures/approved-remaining-eight "$RUNNER_TEMP/approved-eight"
      - name: Preserve only the eight approved speech fixtures for bounded staging acceptance
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: cosmic-approved-remaining-eight-fixtures
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/approved-eight/files/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Upload reviewed lock and fixtures
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: reviewed-release-inputs
          path: |
            package.json
            package-lock.json
            tests/fixtures/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  linux-full:
    name: Linux Worker + integration + browser matrix
    needs: resolve-lock
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '26.7.0'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: reviewed-release-inputs
          path: .
      - run: npm install --global npm@12.0.2 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm ls --all
      - run: npm run deps:install-scripts:verify
      - run: npm audit
      - name: Provision media validation toolchain
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: node scripts/provision-ci-media.mjs
      - run: npm run validate
      - run: npm run test:worker
      - run: npm run test:integration
      - run: npm run browsers:install:ci
      - run: npm run test:e2e:core
      - run: npm run build:inspect

  macos-safari:
    name: macOS native ZIP + WebKit/mobile + Chrome + real Safari
    needs: windows-release
    runs-on: macos-26
    outputs:
      native_safari_outcome: ${{ steps.real-safari.outcome }}
      safari_staging_waiver_outcome: ${{ steps.safari-staging-waiver.outcome }}
      safari_release_exception_outcome: ${{ steps.safari-release-exception.outcome }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/cosmic-native/CosmicTranscriberWeb-${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '26.7.0'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cosmic-archive
      - name: Verify and natively extract the exact Windows staging ZIP
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        env:
          SOURCE_FILE: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.source-file }}
          SOURCE_SHA256: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.source-sha256 }}
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time, zipfile
          source = pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'cosmic-archive' / os.environ['SOURCE_FILE']
          if hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != os.environ['SOURCE_SHA256']:
              raise SystemExit('Windows staging archive identity mismatch.')
          destination = pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE']) / 'cosmic-native'
          if destination.exists():
              raise SystemExit('Native extraction destination must be fresh.')
          root = f"CosmicTranscriberWeb-{os.environ['RELEASE_VERSION']}"
          with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as archive:
              for entry in archive.infolist():
                  parts = pathlib.PurePosixPath(entry.filename).parts
                  if not parts or parts[0] != root or '..' in parts or entry.filename.startswith('/') or '\\' in entry.filename:
                      raise SystemExit('Unsafe or unexpected archive entry.')
              if archive.testzip() is not None:
                  raise SystemExit('Archive CRC verification failed.')
              manifest = json.loads(archive.read(f'{root}/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json'))
              if manifest.get('releaseReady') is not False or manifest.get('certificationLevel') != 'staging':
                  raise SystemExit('macOS must test the unchanged staging-only archive.')
              subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/ditto', '-xk', str(source), str(destination)], check=True)
              for entry in archive.infolist():
                  target = destination / entry.filename
                  if target.read_bytes() != archive.read(entry.filename):
                      raise SystemExit(f'Native extraction byte mismatch: {entry.filename}')
                  if tuple(time.localtime(target.stat().st_mtime)[:6]) != entry.date_time:
                      raise SystemExit(f'Native extraction timestamp mismatch: {entry.filename}')
              print(f'Untouched native archive verified: {source.name}; SHA256={os.environ["SOURCE_SHA256"]}')
          PY
      - run: npm install --global npm@12.0.2 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm ls --all
      - run: npm run deps:install-scripts:verify
      - run: npm audit
      - name: Provision media validation toolchain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v ffprobe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            brew install ffmpeg
          fi
          command -v ffmpeg
          command -v ffprobe
          ffmpeg -version
          ffprobe -version
      - run: npm run validate
      - run: npm run build
      - run: node scripts/playwright-invoke.mjs install webkit chrome
      - run: npm run test:e2e:macos
      - name: Enable SafariDriver
        run: sudo /usr/bin/safaridriver --enable
      - name: Real Safari native files and mocked transcription acceptance
        id: real-safari
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run test:safari:real
      - name: Verify narrowly documented SafariDriver 26.6.2 failure for STAGING ONLY
        id: safari-staging-waiver
        if: ${{ steps.real-safari.outcome == 'failure' }}
        run: node scripts/safari-staging-waiver.mjs test-results/safari-native-acceptance.json
      - name: Record owner-approved exact Safari26 release exception (not Safari certification)
        id: safari-release-exception
        if: ${{ steps.real-safari.outcome == 'failure' }}
        run: node scripts/safari-release-exception.mjs test-results/safari-native-acceptance.json
      - name: Preserve macOS browser evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: macos-native-browser-evidence
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/cosmic-native/CosmicTranscriberWeb-${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.version }}/test-results/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  windows-release:
    name: Windows toolchain + Chrome/Edge + staging-certified ZIP
    needs: resolve-lock
    runs-on: windows-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.certified.outputs.version }}
      artifact-name: ${{ steps.certified.outputs.artifact-name }}
      source-file: ${{ steps.certified.outputs.source-file }}
      source-sha256: ${{ steps.certified.outputs.source-sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '26.7.0'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: reviewed-release-inputs
          path: .
      - name: Activate reviewed npm for shared-lock preflight
        shell: pwsh
        run: npm install --global npm@12.0.2 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm ls --all
      - run: npm run deps:install-scripts:verify
      - run: npm audit
      - name: Execute private Windows toolchain regression/smoke test
        shell: pwsh
        run: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\WINDOWS-TOOLCHAIN-SELFTEST.ps1
      - name: Provision media validation toolchain
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true
          if (-not (Get-Command ffmpeg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -or -not (Get-Command ffprobe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            choco install ffmpeg -y --no-progress
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "ffmpeg provisioning failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
          }
          $ffmpeg = Get-Command ffmpeg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          $ffprobe = Get-Command ffprobe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($null -eq $ffmpeg -or $null -eq $ffprobe) { throw 'ffmpeg/ffprobe provisioning failed.' }
          & $ffmpeg.Source -version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "ffmpeg verification failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
          & $ffprobe.Source -version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "ffprobe verification failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
      - run: npm run validate
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm run browsers:install:branded
      - run: npm run test:e2e:branded
      - run: npm run build:inspect
      - name: Inspect Windows runner socket exhaustion without altering networking
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Output 'Windows TCP ephemeral port ranges:'
          & netsh int ipv4 show dynamicport tcp
          & netsh int ipv6 show dynamicport tcp
          Write-Output 'Socket counts by TCP state:'
          try {
            Get-NetTCPConnection -ErrorAction Stop |
              Group-Object State |
              Sort-Object Name |
              Select-Object Name,Count |
              Format-Table -AutoSize
          } catch { Write-Warning ('TCP diagnostic unavailable: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }
          Write-Output 'Branded browser process counts:'
          try {
            Get-Process -Name chrome,msedge,firefox -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
              Group-Object ProcessName |
              Select-Object Name,Count |
              Format-Table -AutoSize
          } catch { Write-Warning ('Browser process diagnostic unavailable: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }
      - name: Record reviewed lock hash
        id: lock-before
        shell: pwsh
        run: "Write-Output ('hash=' + (Get-FileHash .\\package-lock.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()) >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Run complete Windows certification for staging candidate
        shell: pwsh
        run: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\RELEASE-WINDOWS.ps1
      - name: Prove certification did not alter the reviewed dependency graph
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          LOCK_BEFORE: ${{ steps.lock-before.outputs.hash }}
        run: |
          $after=(Get-FileHash .\package-lock.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($after -ne $env:LOCK_BEFORE) { throw "Release certification changed package-lock.json: before=$env:LOCK_BEFORE after=$after" }
      - name: Verify versioned staging-certified ZIP
        id: certified
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $pkg = Get-Content -LiteralPath .\package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $version = [string]$pkg.version
          if ($version -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$') { throw 'Invalid release package version.' }
          $rootName = "CosmicTranscriberWeb-$version"
          $sourceFile = "$rootName-source.zip"
          $zip = Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path .. $sourceFile)
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $zip.Path -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Staging-certified ZIP missing.' }
          Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
          $archive = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zip.Path)
          try {
            $entry = $archive.GetEntry("$rootName/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json")
            if ($null -eq $entry) { throw 'Staging-certified manifest missing from versioned ZIP root.' }
            $reader = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new($entry.Open())
            try { $manifest = $reader.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json }
            finally { $reader.Dispose() }
          } finally { $archive.Dispose() }
          if ($manifest.version -cne $version -or $manifest.releaseReady -isnot [bool] -or $manifest.releaseReady -ne $false -or $manifest.certificationLevel -cne 'staging') {
            throw 'CI may publish only a matching staging candidate with releaseReady:false.'
          }
          $lockHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath .\package-lock.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($manifest.dependencyLock.status -ne 'verified' -or $manifest.dependencyLock.sha256 -ne $lockHash) {
            throw 'Staging candidate does not contain the reviewed dependency graph.'
          }
          $sourceHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $zip.Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          Write-Output ('path=' + $zip.Path) >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          Write-Output ('version=' + $version) >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          Write-Output ('artifact-name=' + $rootName + '-staging-certified') >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          Write-Output ('source-file=' + $sourceFile) >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          Write-Output ('source-sha256=' + $sourceHash) >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Upload staging-certified candidate
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.certified.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: ${{ steps.certified.outputs.path }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  all-green:
    name: STAGING PREFLIGHT - reviewed Safari26 automation exception, no final release
    needs: [linux-full, macos-safari, windows-release]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require every platform staging gate; only known Safari26 exception permitted
        shell: bash
        env:
          LINUX_RESULT: ${{ needs.linux-full.result }}
          MACOS_RESULT: ${{ needs.macos-safari.result }}
          WINDOWS_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-release.result }}
          NATIVE_SAFARI_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.macos-safari.outputs.native_safari_outcome }}
          SAFARI_WAIVER_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.macos-safari.outputs.safari_staging_waiver_outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$LINUX_RESULT" = success
          test "$MACOS_RESULT" = success
          test "$WINDOWS_RESULT" = success
          if test "$NATIVE_SAFARI_OUTCOME" = success; then
            echo 'Native Safari real-file acceptance PASS.'
          else
            test "$NATIVE_SAFARI_OUTCOME" = failure
            test "$SAFARI_WAIVER_OUTCOME" = success
            echo 'STAGING ONLY: known SafariDriver 26.6.2 native-file failure waived; real Safari NOT CERTIFIED.'
            echo 'Safari26 staging waiver active; staging preflight alone does not authorize final release. See https://github.com/sohweiyu2023/CosmicTranscriberWeb/issues/6' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: certified
      - name: Require unchanged staging-certified ZIP after every CI gate
        shell: bash
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.version }}
          SOURCE_FILE: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.source-file }}
          SOURCE_SHA256: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.source-sha256 }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, zipfile
          version = os.environ['RELEASE_VERSION']
          if not re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?', version):
              raise SystemExit('Invalid release package version.')
          root = f'CosmicTranscriberWeb-{version}'
          filename = f'{root}-source.zip'
          if os.environ['SOURCE_FILE'] != filename:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected staging candidate filename.')
          source = pathlib.Path('certified') / filename
          digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          if digest != os.environ['SOURCE_SHA256']:
              raise SystemExit('Staging candidate checksum changed after Windows certification.')
          with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as archive:
              manifest = json.loads(archive.read(f'{root}/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json'))
              package = json.loads(archive.read(f'{root}/package.json'))
              lock_digest = hashlib.sha256(archive.read(f'{root}/package-lock.json')).hexdigest()
          if manifest.get('version') != version or package.get('version') != version:
              raise SystemExit('Staging candidate version does not match its package.')
          if manifest.get('releaseReady') is not False or manifest.get('certificationLevel') != 'staging':
              raise SystemExit('CI artifact must remain staging-only with releaseReady:false.')
          lock = manifest.get('dependencyLock', {})
          if lock.get('status') != 'verified' or lock.get('sha256') != lock_digest:
              raise SystemExit('Staging candidate dependency-lock provenance is invalid.')
          print(f'{digest}  {source}')
          print('STAGING PREFLIGHT PASS only; native Safari may be explicitly waived and final release remains NOT CERTIFIED.')
          PY

  release-browser-eligibility:
    name: RELEASE BROWSER GATE - native Safari PASS or exact disclosed exception
    needs: [linux-full, macos-safari, windows-release]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require all platforms and genuine Safari PASS or owner-approved exact exception
        shell: bash
        env:
          LINUX_RESULT: ${{ needs.linux-full.result }}
          MACOS_RESULT: ${{ needs.macos-safari.result }}
          WINDOWS_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-release.result }}
          NATIVE_SAFARI_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.macos-safari.outputs.native_safari_outcome }}
          SAFARI_RELEASE_EXCEPTION_OUTCOME: ${{ needs.macos-safari.outputs.safari_release_exception_outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$LINUX_RESULT" = success
          test "$MACOS_RESULT" = success
          test "$WINDOWS_RESULT" = success
          if test "$NATIVE_SAFARI_OUTCOME" = success; then
            echo 'Genuine native Safari automated acceptance PASS.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            test "$NATIVE_SAFARI_OUTCOME" = failure
            test "$SAFARI_RELEASE_EXCEPTION_OUTCOME" = success
            echo 'Native Safari FAIL / WAIVED for the exact owner-approved SafariDriver 26.6.2 signature. Genuine Mac Safari not validated; user-reported iPhone Safari success is separate evidence. All unrelated release requirements remain mandatory. See docs/RELEASE_EXCEPTION_2026-10-22.md.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

  deploy-staging-certified:
    name: Deploy exact staging-verified 1.2 ZIP to STAGING ONLY
    needs: [all-green, windows-release]
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.run_attempt == '1' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/ci/v1.2.0-production-readiness' && needs.all-green.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    environment: staging
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
      STAGING_WORKER_NAME: cosmic-transcriber-web-staging
      STAGING_CF_AUTHORIZATION: ${{ secrets.STAGING_CF_AUTHORIZATION }}
      SOURCE_FILE: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.source-file }}
      SOURCE_SHA256: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.source-sha256 }}
      RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '26.7.0'
      - name: Install exact npm
        run: npm install --global npm@12.0.2 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Fail closed unless staging Cloudflare credentials are available
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(node --version)" = 'v26.7.0'
          test "$(npm --version)" = '12.0.2'
          test -n "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-}" || { echo 'Missing staging environment secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN' >&2; exit 1; }
          test -n "${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-}" || { echo 'Missing staging environment secret CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID' >&2; exit 1; }
      - name: Verify legitimate staging Access before deployment or D1 migration
        run: node scripts/staging-access-preflight.mjs
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.windows-release.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: certified
      - name: Use exact Windows all-green staging source, never a historical artifact
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$RELEASE_VERSION" = '1.2.0'
          test "$SOURCE_FILE" = 'CosmicTranscriberWeb-1.2.0-source.zip'
          test "$SOURCE_SHA256" != ''
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$SOURCE_SHA256" "certified/$SOURCE_FILE" | sha256sum -c -
          test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/ci/v1.2.0-production-readiness | cut -f1)" = "$GITHUB_SHA" || { echo 'Ref advanced after CI; stale candidate must not deploy.' >&2; exit 1; }
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/v12-staging"
          mkdir -p "$root/source"
          unzip -q "certified/$SOURCE_FILE" -d "$root/source"
          candidate="$root/source/CosmicTranscriberWeb-1.2.0"
          chmod -R u+rwX "$candidate"
          test -f "$candidate/package.json"
          test -f "$candidate/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json"
          echo "CANDIDATE=$candidate" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Verify staging-certified non-final identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "$CANDIDATE"
          test "$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" = '1.2.0'
          test "$(node -p "require('./RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').releaseReady")" = 'false'
          test "$(node -p "require('./RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').certificationLevel")" = 'staging'
          test "$(node -p "require('./RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').dependencyLock.status")" = 'verified'
          lock_expected="$(node -p "require('./RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').dependencyLock.sha256")"
          test "$(sha256sum package-lock.json | awk '{print $1}')" = "$lock_expected"
          npm ci
          npm run deps:install-scripts:verify
          npm audit
          npm outdated --depth=0
      - name: Reuse approved private bindings from current staging deployment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          settings="$RUNNER_TEMP/current-staging-settings.json"
          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}" \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}/workers/scripts/${STAGING_WORKER_NAME}/settings" > "$settings"
          SETTINGS_FILE="$settings" node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import {readFile, writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
          import path from 'node:path';
          import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
          const root=process.env.CANDIDATE;
          const response=JSON.parse(await readFile(process.env.SETTINGS_FILE,'utf8'));
          if(response?.success!==true||!response?.result||!Array.isArray(response.result.bindings)) throw new Error('Could not read current staging Worker bindings.');
          const bindings=response.result.bindings;
          const plain=name=>{const b=bindings.find(x=>x?.name===name&&x?.type==='plain_text'); if(!b||typeof b.text!=='string'||!b.text.trim())throw new Error(`Current staging binding ${name} is unavailable.`); return b.text;};
          const d1=bindings.find(x=>x?.name==='USER_DB'&&x?.type==='d1');
          const databaseId=d1?.database_id||d1?.id;
          if(typeof databaseId!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(databaseId)) throw new Error('Current staging USER_DB binding is unavailable.');
          const {applyAccessValues}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root,'scripts/configure-access.mjs')).href);
          const {applyRegistryValues}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root,'scripts/configure-registry.mjs')).href);
          const configPath=path.join(root,'wrangler.jsonc');
          const config=JSON.parse(await readFile(configPath,'utf8'));
          applyAccessValues(config,'staging',plain('ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN'),plain('ACCESS_AUDIENCE'));
          applyRegistryValues(config,'staging',databaseId,plain('ADMIN_EMAILS'));
          await writeFile(configPath,JSON.stringify(config,null,2)+'\n','utf8');
          console.log('Reused current staging Access/admin/D1 bindings without printing private values.');
          NODE
          cd "$CANDIDATE"
          node scripts/deploy-verify.mjs staging
      - name: Confirm existing staging BYOK secret without replacing it
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "$CANDIDATE"
          node scripts/wrangler-invoke.mjs secret list --env staging --format json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/v12-staging-secret-names.json"
          node -e "const x=require(process.argv[1]); if (!Array.isArray(x)||!x.some(y=>y?.name==='BYOK_SESSION_MASTER_KEY_CURRENT'))process.exit(1)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/v12-staging-secret-names.json" || { echo 'Existing staging BYOK master secret missing; refusing to deploy.' >&2; exit 1; }
          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/v12-staging-secret-names.json"
      - name: Record known-good staging version for rollback
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd "$CANDIDATE"
          node scripts/wrangler-invoke.mjs deployments list --env staging
      - name: Deploy STAGING ONLY
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "$CANDIDATE"
          npm run deploy:staging
      - name: Staging reachability smoke
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' --max-time 20 https://transcriber-staging.awakeningtoreality.com/)"
          case "$code" in
            2*|3*|401|403) echo "Staging endpoint reachable through expected app/Access boundary: HTTP $code" ;;
            *) echo "Unexpected staging HTTP status: $code" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
      - name: Record newly deployed staging version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd "$CANDIDATE"
          node scripts/wrangler-invoke.mjs deployments list --env staging
      - name: Reassert release boundary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "$CANDIDATE"
          test "$(node -p "require('./RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').releaseReady")" = 'false'
          test "$(node -p "require('./RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').certificationLevel")" = 'staging'
          echo 'STAGING deployment only. Production remains blocked until live staging acceptance passes.'

  staging-live-nine-formats:
    name: Actual authenticated STAGING paid nine-format acceptance
    needs: [deploy-staging-certified]
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.run_attempt == '1' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/ci/v1.2.0-production-readiness' && needs.deploy-staging-certified.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    environment: staging
    env:
      STAGING_CF_AUTHORIZATION: ${{ secrets.STAGING_CF_AUTHORIZATION }}
      STAGING_OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.STAGING_OPENAI_API_KEY }}
      COSMIC_PAID_STAGING_MODE: exact-nine-real-requests
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '26.7.0'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Run bounded nine-format paid staging acceptance, no ambiguous retries
        run: node scripts/staging-live-acceptance.mjs
      - name: Preserve sanitized nine-format paid receipts
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: staging-live-nine-format-evidence
          path: test-results/staging-live-acceptance.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
